data.name: Wilfried
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Wil' (will) and 'frid' (peace). In Old English, it means 'strong ruler'. In Christian tradition, it represents the peace and strength that comes from a strong will.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace and strength, rooted in one's personal will.

data.cultural_impact: The name Wilfried was popular among the European peoples, particularly the Germans, during the Middle Ages. It was a name given to a ruler or a warrior who was expected to exhibit strength and courage in all his undertakings. In the feudal system, knights and lords were often given names that reflected their expected roles and qualities. Wilfried, therefore, was a name that instilled a sense of dignity and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, Wilfried represents the peace and strength that comes from a strong will. It reminds us of the importance of having a clear conviction and purpose in our lives. It also reminds us of God's power and protection, symbolized by the name's Old English meaning of a 'strong ruler'. Wilfred, as a Christian name, is a powerful reminder of the strength and peace that can be found in trusting and surrendering to God's will.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Wilfried of Poitiers (c. 510-570) was a Frankish bishop and historian. The name Wilfried carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Wilfried remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Wilfried from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Wilfried - "Rule in peace". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Wilfried: "Battle-Ruler of Peace". A name evoking the inner strength and determination needed to maintain peace in the midst of conflict. This name reminds us of the power of God to bring peace in our lives despite the turmoil around us.
